# Cave wall: big faceted rocks standing round the back and the sides of the floor (1-3 m tall).
# Generated by make_env.py (positions and sizes seeded). Static.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.259 0.431 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name W0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1 --location -5.400 3.468 0
scale 0.713 0.570 1.839
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 1
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name W1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1 --location -4.437 3.452 0
